correctness.rationale: Ball formulas, strict complete-graph comparison and leaf self-row exclusion are proved for all m>=1. Orthogonal row-selection compression gives exact formula with at most 4(m+1) blocks of order at most four. Exact integer Sylvester checks on 126 selections (121 strict, five exceptional) and exact cubic eigenvector algebra prove the m=3 equality classification; finite checks are not extrapolated.

value.rationale: The natural minimal perturbation of a complete graph strictly changes a nonlinear maximal norm for every order, yet admits an exact linear-size low-rank spectral reduction despite exponentially many raw row choices; the five-vertex member exhibits the first mixed universal-hub extremizer with a complete three-ray classification.
